Excel workbook statistics calculation failed with #NAME? errors in the 'Task' worksheet.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed because cells H46:L47 returned #NAME? instead of expected numeric values. This error typically indicates an unrecognized function name or invalid named range in an Excel formula. Affected cells include H46 (expected -1.5915), I46 (expected -1.4701), and H47 (expected 3.0095). The failure occurred during assert_matrix(ws, EXPECTED_STATS, "statistics") in /tests/test_outputs.py.
